scope: Initial local objectives; qualify on the target installation before adopting production SLOs

alerts.name: process_admission_delay
alerts.diagnostic: Check local byte admission, engine health and queue workers; local saturation does not consume provider attempts
alerts.repair: Restore capacity or the failed worker; keep existing start-job identities

alerts.name: process_observation_stalled
alerts.diagnostic: Inspect the last observation and provider status; export the Process before retention
alerts.repair: Resume polling; repair uncertain delivery only with destination evidence, never resubmit generation blindly

alerts.name: uncertain_delivery
alerts.diagnostic: Distinguish unconfirmed submission from delivery_unknown in the Process error code
alerts.repair: Use the existing audited delivery-resolution action after inspecting the destination

alerts.name: event_loop_delay
alerts.diagnostic: Correlate CPU, file IO and provider buffering; the calendar calculator is independently bounded
alerts.repair: Reduce competing work and restore failed components; do not weaken resource limits
